name: Reconstruction Neighborhood Registry
purpose: Define bounded neighborhoods describing which projections retain partial mutual reconstructability under controlled loss conditions.

neighborhood_classes.definition: Projections sharing a direct source-relation trace with minimal deformation.
Projections where some lost features can be recovered through multi-projection alignment.
Neighborhoods defined by irreducible projection conflicts (e.g., discrete/smooth tension).
Boundaries where projection distortion prevents any meaningful reconstruction.
Projections completely detached from recoverable source metadata.

metrics.definition: Measures the density of shared source metadata within a neighborhood.
Quantifies how localized the reconstruction information is within the projection set.
metrics.calculation: inverse of the dispersion of recovery metadata

metrics.definition: Evaluates whether neighborhood boundaries explicitly preserve projection distinctions.
Measures if losses are isolated to specific neighborhood classes or diffused.

neighborhood_requirements: RN_LOCAL_TRACE requires SILVER+ trace quality score.
No neighborhood may claim source identity.

governance_rules.rule: Neighborhoods are analytic containers for comparison, not physical regions.
High overlap density does not prove source identity.

forbidden_claims: Reconstruction neighborhoods represent physical spacetime regions.
High locality scores derive physical particles.
